groups.activity: conservation or fishing for Ostron standing
groups.mode: Loki with Equinox's Sleep subsumed, or Ivara's Sleep Arrow

rows.label: Visitor rank-up
rows.note: 22,000 standing, 25,000cr, 10 Tear Azurite, 40 Pyrol, 60 Fish Scales; unlocks both refining blueprints

rows.label: Trusted rank-up
rows.note: 44,000 standing, 50,000cr, 1 Cetus Wisp, 5 Maprico; unlocks gilding

conditions: Animals, fish and gems all count against the daily Ostron cap, so the climb spans several days.
Budget the part blueprints, both 5,000-standing refining blueprints and the 5,000-standing gild on top of the rank-ups.
bonuses: Tranq or sleep wildlife at the two ponds just outside the Cetus gate, then leave and re-enter to respawn them; players cap in 10-15 minutes.
Murkray fishing works any time of day, Glappid and Cuthol at night; Oxylus shows hotspots and the fish give Fish Scales too.
Thumpers drop Veridos, and spare gems trade to Suumbaat for 75 standing each.

groups.activity: buy the Strike, Grip and Link blueprints

rows.label: Laka Grip Blueprint
rows.alt: a two-handed Grip makes a Polearm

conditions: Mastery belongs to the Strike alone; pair it with the cheapest Grip and Link.
Forging consumes all three parts and a Zaw can never be taken apart.

groups.activity: mine, refine, fish and gather the build materials

rows.label: Fersteel Alloy
rows.note: Strike; two refines of 20 Ferros, 400 Plastids, 200 Rubedo, 1,000cr

rows.label: Cryotic
rows.note: Laka Grip; Excavation, not the Plains

rows.label: Cetus Wisp
rows.note: gild; Plains lakes, mostly at night

conditions: The Marquise Veridos and Fersteel refining blueprints are 5,000 standing each from Suumbaat and need Visitor rank.
bonuses: A Resource Booster doubles the Thumper gem haul.

rows.label: Dehtat Strike
rows.note: 5,000cr, 2 Maprico, 45 Fish Scales, 8 Marquise Veridos, 40 Fersteel Alloy

rows.label: Laka Grip
rows.note: 5,000cr, 20 Nistlepod, 60 Coprite Alloy, 50 Fish Oil, 750 Cryotic

rows.label: Ruhang Link
rows.note: 5,000cr, 10 Nistlepod, 20 Pyrotic Alloy, 2 Kuaka Spinal Claw, 5 Mawfish Bones

rows.label: gild
rows.note: 2 Cetus Wisp + 5,000 Ostron standing, Trusted rank; resets to rank 0

rows.label: level to 30 again
rows.note: this pass is what pays Mastery

conditions: An ungilded Zaw gives no Mastery, and once one Dehtat Zaw is gilded and mastered, another gives nothing.
bonuses: Donate spare rank-30 Zaws to Hok for standing toward the next Strike.
